name: priority:p0
description: Critical — production impact, data loss, or security breach. Fix immediately.

name: priority:p1
description: High — major functionality broken or release-blocking. Fix in current milestone.

name: priority:p2
description: Normal — standard development priority. Schedule in upcoming sprint.

name: priority:p3
description: Low — nice to have or minor polish. Fix when capacity allows.

name: type:bug
description: Something is not working as expected.

name: type:feature
description: New functionality or an enhancement to existing behaviour.

name: type:docs
description: Documentation-only change — no code affected.

name: type:chore
description: Build system, dependency update, or housekeeping. No production behaviour change.

name: type:refactor
description: Code restructuring that does not fix a bug or add a feature.

name: type:test
description: Adding, fixing, or improving tests only.

name: type:security
description: Security vulnerability, hardening, or compliance-driven code change.

name: status:blocked
description: Cannot progress — waiting on an external dependency or decision.

name: status:in-progress
description: Actively being worked on by an assignee.

name: status:needs-review
description: Implementation complete — awaiting code or design review.

name: status:wontfix
description: Acknowledged but will not be addressed. Reason should be in comments.

name: epic
description: Parent issue tracking a large work stream spanning multiple issues or sprints.

name: release-blocker
description: Must be resolved before the current milestone can ship.

name: needs-info
description: More context or reproduction steps required from the reporter.

name: good-first-issue
description: Well-scoped and welcoming for a first contribution.

name: duplicate
description: This issue or PR already exists elsewhere — link to original.

name: bot:fix-please
description: Opt-in: request the AI bot to attempt an automatic fix.

name: bot:skip
description: Skip all bot processing on this issue or PR.

name: bot:fixed
description: Bot has opened a PR that may resolve this issue.

name: bot:low-confidence
description: Bot attempted a fix but could not complete it — needs human review.

name: bot:reviewed
description: This PR or issue has been reviewed by the automated bot.

name: auto-fixable
description: Bot assessment: this issue is likely resolvable via automated tooling.
